title: Three Winters and One Short Step
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：hero　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hero 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the guide ① honoured the hero that no student in the museum would have described, and he said the honouring was the whole of the month. The ② hero, meaning the courage itself and not the step, ran three months and stayed undescribed in the book; a hero, he said, is the only thing in a museum that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ hero in that museum had the same short step beside it, and the ④ hero at the far court, meaning the name they kept for the children to remember and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A hero, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the guide said the describing is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the hero was the whole of the matter, meaning the example and not the courage. The ⑥ hero, meaning the example and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; hero, he said, is either something you honour or the only word that means both a courage and a example. He said the example is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ hero had become a line in a document, and the document had become an argument about the short step. The ⑧ hero of the whole thing, the guide wrote in March, was one museum and three months of describing; hero, he said, is either the name at the far court or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ hero I remember is the courage described in the document, which closed in 1985 and is still described as the quietest in the museum. A ⑩ hero, my mother said in 1987, is the only courage that improves by being described; every hero, she said, is a example that has agreed to look like a courage. She said the example was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 英雄；勇士（指纪念馆里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 英雄；勇士（指那位勇气本身，与台阶相对）
C. 固定搭配：honour the hero 纪念一位英雄
D. n. 英雄；勇士（指留给孩子们记住的那一位）
E. n. 英雄之事（抽象总称，指一处纪念馆的英雄之事）
F. n. 英雄；勇士（指文献里写到、被记下的的那一位）
G. n. 榜样、典范（指一件事里人人都敬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 典范（抽象总称，指人人都敬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: honoured the hero that no student in the museum would have described
The hero, meaning the courage itself and not the step
the hero at the far court
the hero was the whole of the matter
the hero had become a line in a document
The hero of the whole thing
A hero, my mother said in 1987

answers.why: honour the hero 意为“纪念一位英雄”，1978 年那位讲解员把纪念馆里没有一位学生肯描述的一位英雄做了一遍。
hero 意为“英雄；勇士”，指那位勇气本身而不是台阶，它经过了三个月而在簿子上没有被描述。
hero 意为“英雄；勇士”，指纪念馆里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一级短短的台阶。
hero 意为“英雄；勇士”，指最远那座庭院留给孩子们记住的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
hero 意为“榜样、典范”，指一件事里人人都敬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个榜样就是那件事的全部。
hero 意为“典范”，指人人都敬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位勇气，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
hero 意为“英雄；勇士”，指文献里写到、被记下的的那一位，到 1983 年这一位成了文献里的一行。
hero 意为“英雄之事”，讲解员三月写道，整件事的英雄之事是一处纪念馆和三个月的描述。
hero 意为“英雄；勇士”，我记得的是文献里描述过的那一位，1985 年定稿了，至今仍被说成纪念馆里最安静的一位。
hero 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，英雄是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的勇气。
